[id="reducing-model-loading-time-with-model-cache"]
= Reduce model loading time with model cache

[role="_abstract"]
As a cluster administrator, you can enable model cache to pre-download large machine learning models to local node storage or network volumes.
Model cache reduces inference service cold-start times from 15-20 minutes to about one minute for large models, enabling faster autoscaling and shorter deployment cycles.
As a data scientist, you can deploy inference services that automatically use cached models without modifying your deployment YAML.

include::modules/understanding-model-cache.adoc[leveloffset=+1]

You can cache models on local node disks for cross-namespace sharing, or on network volumes by using a custom `StorageClass`.
